data.narrative:
HEO is a Series A space & aerospace company founded by Dr. Will Crowe and Dr. Hiranya Jayakody, having raised $12M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 5 public space & aerospace companies (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers spanning similar and adjacent stages, including Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Two triangulation methods proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $12M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression, implies a $24M valuation. Peer-median analysis across 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Cowboy Space at $2.0B Series B, Aalyria at $1.3B Series B, and Starcloud at $1.1B Seed) yields a median of $1.3B, with a range of $1.1B to $2.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applicable due to the absence of target revenue data, though the broader Space & Aerospace public market trades at a 25.3x price-to-sales median.

The triangulated valuation range spans $20M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $662M. The wide dispersion reflects stage uncertainty: stage-progression implies early-stage pricing, while peer-median reflects later-stage valuations in the space sector. Resolution depends critically on HEO's revenue trajectory, technology differentiation, and actual comparability to Series B-funded competitors.
